import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get necessary objects
scan = application.Scan
opmode = application.OperatingMode

# Set operating mode to Dynamic AFM (tapping mode) to minimize tip damage
opmode.OperatingMode = spm.OperatingMode.DynamicAFM

# Set scan parameters
scan.ImageWidth = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 20e-6  # 20 µm in meters
scan.Points = 128  # points per line
scan.Lines = 128  # lines per frame

print(f"Scan parameters set:")
print(f"  Size: {scan.ImageWidth*1e6} x {scan.ImageHeight*1e6} µm²")
print(f"  Resolution: {scan.Points} x {scan.Lines} points")
print(f"  Operating Mode: Dynamic AFM (tapping mode)")

# Start the scan
print("\nStarting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Get the file path of the saved image
# The image is automatically saved by the AFM software
# We need to get the gallery history path
try:
    gallery_path = application.GetGalleryHistoryPath()
    print(f"\nImage saved at: {gallery_path}")
except:
    print("\nAttempting to get save location...")
    # Alternative: check default save location
    gallery_path = "Image saved in gallery"

del spm
"}

import os

# Get current working directory from the AFM system
current_dir = r'C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_3_tool_calling_brief\enviroment\subtasks_3\image_capture_2_subtask_level_3_trial_3'

# Get the most recent .nid file (should be the one we just created)
if nid_files:
    # Sort by modification time to get the most recent
    nid_files_with_time = [(f, os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(current_dir, f))) for f in nid_files]
    nid_files_with_time.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    latest_file = nid_files_with_time[0][0]
